seed_ledger.name: Limitless Energy Hub Power Station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: Third pass, no supply pipe found. Three searches found only ERCOT queue listings for Limitless Energy Hub I and II (about 1,238 MW each, December 2028) and a developer page listing Vernon as 2 GW of new gas generation in development. No source ties the plant to a data center or names a gas supply pipe. The nearest mapped line is Atmos Pipeline Texas (P0369) at 4.2 km, which is not confirmed as the supplier. The Railroad Commission, FERC, the EIA pipeline projects workbook and the TCEQ air permit were not reached. Kept as monitor for a later look once the plant has a permit or a supply contract is announced.
